label: Illustrative example: a gym's plans, from a monthly membership to a corporate plan with named seats, with the billing rules set once for all of them.
title: Plans
subtitle: What members buy. A price change applies to new members; existing members keep their price until you move them.

items.title: Monthly Unlimited
items.body: Gym floor and every class. Renews on the 1st. Freeze up to 30 days a year. 214 members.

items.title: Annual
items.body: Everything in Monthly, paid once a year. Reminder 30 days before it renews. 96 members.

items.title: 10-class pack
items.body: Any 10 classes in 60 days. Does not renew; top up when used. No gym floor. 71 members.

items.title: Student
items.body: Gym floor and off-peak classes. Student ID checked when they join. No freezes. 58 members.

items.title: Corporate · 10 seats
items.body: One invoice to the company for ten named members. If the company owes, its seats stop at the door. 6 companies.

items.title: Day pass
items.body: Gym floor for one day, sold at the desk. The QR card is emailed. 154 sold in October.

blocks.title: Billing, set once for all plans

items.label: Reminders
items.value: Day 1, 3 and 7 after the due date

items.label: First part-month
items.value: Charged by the day from joining

items.title: Monthly Unlimited goes to ₦27,500 for new members on 1 Nov
items.body: The 214 members on it keep ₦25,000 until you move them. Each one you move shows as a price change on the next billing run.
